artifact.summary: Abstained. The abstract and specification do not give the explicit Szegedy-type unitary for open quantum walks: the OQW Kraus operators, the Hilbert-space structure, the gate decomposition of U and the initial state are all missing. Any circuit would be an invented construction rather than a reconstruction. The only supplied equations are node-probability, time-average and limit definitions, which are measurement or classical post-processing and not circuit operations.

equation_mapping.explanation: Node probability P_t(x)=Tr[Pi_x U^t rho_0 U^dagger t] is a readout definition that depends on the unspecified U and Pi_x. The runner would apply it after the operation is built, so it is not a circuit operation.
The Cesaro time average of P_t(x) is classical post-processing over many circuit runs and is not a unitary operation.
The T->infinity limit is an analytic or asymptotic quantity. It cannot be built as a finite circuit, and the paper's closed form is not given in the abstract.

specification_changes.change: No circuit construction was implemented. The scope is narrowed to nothing, and the equations are treated only as background or out-of-scope definitions.
specification_changes.reason: The explicit unitary needed to define U, and therefore eq_1, is not in the supplied material. Eq_2 and eq_3 are classical post-processing and a limit. Implementing a guessed Szegedy-type walk would change the scientific meaning.

assumptions: The probability and mean-probability equations were inferred from the abstract and are not the paper's own definitions.
No register sizes or coin structure are adopted, because they were only assumed in the specification.
unresolved_issues: Explicit unitary construction from the OQW Kraus operators is not given.
The Hilbert space and the node projectors Pi_x are not defined.
The initial state and the circuit realization are not given.
The gate decomposition of the walk operator U is not given.
The closed form of the asymptotic mean probability is not given.
A concrete graph or transition-operator instance format is needed before any build_circuit can be written.
